name: Spitz
source:
Department of Mechanical Engineering; Dog (Spitz)

In Therio terms, this student who doesn't raid the lab or develop hazardous materials is quite odd.

By human standards, this girl would be your average engineering student, but she's a rare sight at a Therio university.
